TCB_honesty_rule: A third-party parser used by the independent source-evidence lane is part of the syntactic TCB and must be version-pinned. The project may not claim the extractor is outside the TCB until every claim-critical fact consumed by the certificate checker is independently re-derived from raw bytes.

C0_SHARED_FRONTEND_CONDITIONAL.definition: A separately implemented checker recomputes semantic aggregation but consumes claim-critical facts that originated from or are shared with the primary frontend/extractor.

C1_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE.definition: The checker re-derives every claim-critical local source/control/binding fact from exact raw source bytes using a source-evidence extraction implementation not shared with the primary E2 semantic-flow producer, then independently recomputes the supported semantic obligations.
C1_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE.use: Minimum assurance level eligible to support a definitive Candidate-58 E2_PREDICTED_* semantic claim.

C2_PROOF_OBJECT_CHECKED.definition: Optional future proof-producing symbolic/SMT lane whose proof object is checked by a smaller independent proof checker.
C2_PROOF_OBJECT_CHECKED.use: Optional stronger lane; not required by v0.1 and must not silently enlarge the supported fragment.

certificate_envelope_required: protocol ids/versions and exact content digests
case id and exact source/target content hashes

checker_independence_rules.disagreement: Any material primary/checker disagreement blocks definitive promotion and yields E2_PREDICTED_ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE while preserving both outputs.
must_not_import_or_trust: primary summarized semantic-flow fact as authoritative evidence
must_recompute: authority/hash bindings and closed read set
minimal-fragment admission for every material claim fact
claim-critical source spans/AST or structured-control facts from raw bytes
all declared preservation obligations for preservation
final machine prediction from the recomputed obligations

checker_outputs.INVALID_CERTIFICATE: A claimed fact, hash, obligation, or verdict fails independent recomputation.
checker_outputs.UNSUPPORTED_CERTIFICATE: The claim requires semantics outside the frozen minimal fragment or evidence unavailable to the checker.
checker_outputs.VALID_C0_CONDITIONAL: Semantic checker passes only conditional on shared primary/frontend facts; insufficient for definitive Candidate-58 semantic promotion.
checker_outputs.VALID_C1: All C1 independent-source-evidence and semantic checks pass.

minimum_TCB_for_C1: exact immutable raw source/target bytes and their cryptographic digests
frozen canonical seed consequence signature and frozen CTV consequence semantics
language parser/runtime dependencies actually used by the source-evidence rechecker, with exact versions/digests
canonical JSON/hash routines used for content addressing
promotion_rule: For Candidate-58 v0.1, only VALID_C1 or a separately frozen stronger C2 result may support E2_PREDICTED_REGRESSION_WITNESS or E2_PREDICTED_PRESERVATION_EVIDENCE. C0, invalid, unsupported, or disagreement is fail-closed.
purpose: Make proof-carrying claims honest by separating the complex E2 producer from the minimum independently rechecked evidence and semantic calculus.
untrusted_producer_side: support/admission proposal emitted by the producer
LLM assistance, generated probes, SMT search, and future repair synthesis

incomplete: provenance identifying where the proof stopped
no implication of regression absence or preservation
preservation: declared finite admitted worlds/scope or an exact finite enumeration artifact
nonempty source and target consequence interpretations
all applicable A3_P1-P5 and A4_P1-P7 obligation results
evidence sufficient to independently recompute complete-path/lineage/control closure
regression: concrete world pair or canonical pair identifiers
target realization/effect-outcome relation needed for the collapse witness
all witness-local material source/control/binding evidence sufficient for independent recomputation
